comments.author: @KeithMercer-q6g
comments.text: The thought of a passing stranger being invited to sit with a family really draws me in. I’d love to hear what that evening pause means to the people who keep it.

replies.author: @TravelHorizon-4K
replies.text: Shrinking cannery jobs [22:31], saltwater intrusion affecting taro plots on Aunuu [32:07], and declining reef fish [33:16] show the island caught between creating livelihoods and protecting its rainforest, reefs, and way of life [29:20]. For a small, isolated island, is sustainable development better served by small-scale, low-impact local enterprise or larger outside investment?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It is truly heartwarming to see how such a simple, shared moment of stillness can foster such deep connection and hospitality toward strangers!
